── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────────
The open short is on the right side of the structure — BTC has not closed above 1m EMA300 once in the last 2 hours (0/119), 1h linreg -0.24, and SL 68551 correctly sits just above the reclaim level (EMA300 68484). What has changed is the near-term tape: aggregate flipped LONG_BIAS at 00:00 and held 55 minutes, price rallied 68289→68412 → 68342, and the short is now -0.50% with only 0.31% of room to the stop. The winning side of the last 2 hours has been LONG; we stay short because the 6.6h below-EMA300 structure has not broken — the reclaim-exit condition, not the flip label, is the decision rule.

Entry quality remains the whole story: 93.5% of 7d gross loss comes from trades that never reached +0.40% MFE (avg loser MFE 0.247), NULL-mfe pinned at 0 so it is not a backfill artifact. 24h closes: 16T 8W +$0.09 — flat, with all four losses on counter-trend LONGs (JUP/INJ/BTC/IOTA) whose winning side was SHORT/no-trade, while the MNT SHORT@RSI 74 loss shows RSI alone does not separate (losers span RSI 21-88; 24h winners avg LONG 43.8 / SHORT 35.2). The separator stays armed-vs-never-armed: 7d losers are 42T 0W -$4.33 across atr_sl_hit/hard_max_loss/manual_sl_hit, while profit-monster-trail winners are 30T 29W +$1.56. Open trade entered at meta_rsi 19.6 (oversold) — aggressive per the BANANA-SHORT lesson, but the same-window counter-examples (BTC shorts entered RSI 12.6 and 25.5 won +8.3%/+6.4%) show low-RSI shorts in a bear structure are not automatically wrong; entry RSI is not the lever, never-armed entries are.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────────
1. Keep 16902 short with the standing condition: exit if 1m holds above EMA300 68484 for 15-30m (verified still below at 00:52); widen SL to ~68650 only if giving the thesis room past the reclaim zone. age=3.
2. Route entry-quality pass to brain-auditor: bleed ≥92% all windows + LONG arm tripwire 43.6% + trend-gate disagreement (4 counter-T LONGs 24h). age=3.
3. No new manual entries while 7d bleed = 93.5%; 5 slots stay idle rather than feed the never-armed cohort.
